newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA COACH, TWO PLAYERS SHOWN RED CARDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA COACH, TWO PLAYERS SHOWN RED CARDS.

text.p: Benfica's Brazilian coach Paulo Autuori and two of his players were shown red cards on Monday night in a stormy home 1-1 draw with Boavista in the Portuguese first division.
Referee Isidoro Rodrigues left the pitch at the end of the game amid a hail of plastic bottles and jeers from angry Benfica supporters in the 15,000 crowd.
Portuguese international Helder Cristovao was dismissed for a second bookable offence after 55 minutes when the home side were winning 1-0, thanks to a goal from Bulgarian midfielder Ilian Iliev.

But the real trouble erupted some 10 minutes from the end when captain Joao Pinto was given his marching orders for protesting at a penalty awarded when the referee judged he had brought down Boavista striker Manuel Tulipa in the area.
Autuori was expelled in the same incident.
Trinidad and Tobago midfielder Nigel Latapi missed with his spot kick but Boavista finally levelled the score with a last minute effort from Surinam striker Jerrel Jimmy.
Benfica stay second in the league, three points behind champions Porto.
